title: Madoka Magica -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- Anime Film Opens in Taiwan on September 4
content:
Taiwanese streaming service Bahamut Animation Crazy announced last week that Muse Asia will open Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie: Walpurgisnacht: Rising ( Gekijōban Mahō Shōjo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten ), the official sequel to the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion film, in Taiwan on September 4.

Yukihiro Miyamoto ( Puella Magi Madoka Magica , Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story , Arakawa Under the Bridge ) is directing the film.

The returning cast includes:

• Aoi Yūki as Madoka Kaname

• Chiwa Saitō as Homura Akemi

• Kaori Mizuhashi as Mami Tomoe

• Eri Kitamura as Sayaka Miki

• Ai Nonaka as Kyōko Sakura

• Kana Asumi as Nagisa Momoe

• Emiri Katō as Kyubey

Shion Wakayama voices the new magical girl Shichōka, and Tomoyo Kurosawa voices Selma Therese.

The anime film will feature a returning staff from the original anime series and films, including original creators Magica Quartet , chief director Akiyuki Simbo , scriptwriter Gen Urobuchi of Nitroplus , original character designer Ume Aoki , animation character designer Junichirō Taniguchi , composer Yuki Kajiura , alternate space designer Gekidan Inu Curry , and animation studio SHAFT .

The new and returning staff members are:

• Chief Animation Directors: Junichirō Taniguchi, Hiroki Yamamura

• storyboard/Visual Concept Design: Tomohiro Furukawa (new)

• Visual Concept Design: Kazuki Kawada

• Color Key Artist: Jin Hibino

• Art: Ken Naitō (returnng), Shūichi Kusamori (new)

• Art Setting: Morihito Ōhara

• Compositing Director of Photography: Takayuki Aizu

• Editing: Rie Matsubara

• Sound Director: Yōta Tsuruoka

Yuki Kajiura 's solo project FictionJunction perform the theme song "Kanata."

SHAFT first hinted at a new work in the franchise through a concept movie in 2015, but the film was only announced in April 2021.

The film has suffered numerous previous delays, the most recent of which happened in January due to production circumstances, delaying the movie from a planned opening in February. Prior to this most recent delay, the film was previously slated to open in Japan in winter 2024, but was delayed in August 2024 to winter 2025, before the delay to February 2026.

The television edition of the Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 1: Beginnings and Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 2: Eternal compilation films began airing in October 2025.

The original 12-episode Puella Magi Madoka Magica television anime premiered in January 2011. The Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 1: Beginnings and Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 2: Eternal compilation films opened in Japan in October 2012, and then the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion sequel film opened in October 2013.

A television anime adaptation of the Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story smartphone game premiered in January 2020. The anime's second season premiered in July 2021. The third and final season debuted in April 2022.

The smartphone game launched for iOS and Android devices in Japan in August 2017, and was free to play with optional in-game purchases. The English version launched in the United States and Canada in June 2019. The English version of the game ended service in September 2020, and the Japanese version ended service in July 2024.

The Puella Magi Madoka Magica : Magia Exedra smartphone game launched in March 2025, following a delay from 2024 for the staff to "ensure even higher quality in the final game." The game got a version for PC via Steam in July 2025.
author: ANN

title: Muse Asia Licenses The World's Strongest Witch, Firefly Wedding Anime
content:
Muse Asia announced on Friday and Saturday that it has licensed The World's Strongest Witch anime and the Firefly Wedding anime. Muse Asia will announce streaming details for the anime at a later date.

The television anime of Mochimaru Sakaki 's The World's Strongest Witch : I'm Starting My Free Life in a World Where Only I Can See the Online Strategy Guide ( Sekai Saikyō no Majo, Hajimemashita : Watashi dake "Kōryaku Site" o Mireru Sekai de Jiyū ni Ikimasu ) light novel series will premiere in Japan on October 7.

Yen Press is releasing the light novels in English, and released the second volume on April 14. Yen Press describes the story:

When Lorna manifests a completely useless ability, she's labeled an embarrassment to her family and kicked out of the house. With no money or food, she's about to hit rock bottom. But then, she figures out how to use her supposedly worthless SSS-Rank skill, “Internet.” This cheat-level talent gives her the know-how to gather an unlimited amount of valuable items and easily acquire rare equipment. Armed with godlike knowledge, Lorna's free to do anything she wants! If only she could figure out what “lmfao” means…

The cast members include:

• Azusa Tachibana as protagonist Rona Hermit

• Fairouz Ai as Erimina, the master of the adverturers' guild known as the "Inferno Witch"

• Honoka Inoue as Eruna, an elf princess who worries over her sick mother

• Kana Hanazawa as Aries Tear Bluemoon, a guildmaster in the port town of Aquas

• Maria Naganawa as Ruru Ru Rie, the young water dragon princess of the underwater kingdom

Jōji Furuta ( ēlDLIVE , Double Decker! Doug & Kirill , Bad Girl ) is directing the anime at the studios Bridge and Aisle . Shoji Yonemura ( Pokémon Journeys: The Series , One Piece 2013-onwards, Bad Girl ) is in charge of the series scripts. Yūki Morimoto ( Cardfight!! Vanguard GZ , Boarding School Juliet , Bad Girl ) is designing the characters.

The television anime of Oreko Tachibana 's Firefly Wedding manga will premiere in Japan on October 9.

Viz Media publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story:

On the surface, Satoko has it all—she's beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family's eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

The anime will star Lynn as Satoko Kirigaya and Kōki Uchiyama as Shinpei Gotō. Additional cast members include Kent Itō as Kōtarō Ogawa and Kenjirō Tsuda as Mitsueda.

Takahiro Kamei (2022-2024's Urusei Yatsura ) is directing the anime at david production , and Yukiko Aikei ( Horizon in the Middle of Nowhere , Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop , Your Lie in April ) is designing the characters. Yūko Kakihara (2022-2024 Urusei Yatsura series, IRODUKU: The World in Colors , Blue Box ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts, and NOGRID is composing the music.
author: ANN

title: Odex Opens Detective Conan: Fallen Angel of the Highway Film in Singapore on September 5
content:
Odex announced last Thursday that its screening of Detective Conan: Highway no Datenshi ( Detective Conan : Fallen Angel of the Highway ), the franchise 's 29th film , in Singapore will open on September 5. The film will screen exclusively in Golden Village cinemas.

The film opened in Japan on April 10.

The film sold 2,318,009 tickets and earned 3,502,137,800 yen (about US$21.9 million) in its first three days, making a new opening-weekend record for the franchise , and debuting at #1 at the Japanese box office.

The film is now the fourth consecutive film in the franchise to earn more than 10 billion yen, beginning with 2023's Detective Conan: Black Iron Submarine film. The film has earned a cumulative total of 13,608,566,400 yen (about US$83.06 million) as of July 19.

The new film centers on the character Chihaya Hagiwara, member of the Kanagawa Prefectural Police and the leader of its motorcycle division. Miyuki Sawashiro now voices the character, replacing the late Atsuko Tanaka . The movie also features Kanagawa inspector Jugo Yokomizo, teenage detective Masumi Sera, Chihaya's late younger brother Kenji Hagiwara, and Kenji's Police Academy classmate Jinpei Matsuda.

The previous film in the franchise , Detective Conan: One-eyed Flashback ( Meitantei Conan: Sekigan no Flashback ), had teased the character's appearance at the end of the film.

Takahiro Hasui ( Detective Conan: The Black Iron Submarine ) directed the film, and Takahiro Ōkura ( Detective Conan: The Crimson Love Letter ) wrote the script. Yūgo Kanno ( Detective Conan: One-eyed Flashback composed the music for the film.

Detective Conan: One-eyed Flashback opened in Japan on April 18, 2025, and debuted at #1 at the Japanese box office. The film became the #19 highest-grossing film of all time in Japan in June 2025, and is currently the 20th highest-grossing film in Japan of all time, having earned 14.74 billion yen (about US$95.1 million). Katsuya Shigehara (unit director of Detective Conan: Kurogane no Submarine ) directed the film. Takeharu Sakurai (various Detective Conan movies) wrote the script.
author: ANN

title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects Anime Streams on Tropics Anime YouTube Channel in India
content:
The Tropics Anime YouTube channel began streaming the television anime of Fuurou 's The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects ( Ryōmin 0-nin Start no Henkyō Ryōshu-sama ) light novel series in India on July 31. The channel is also streaming the Death Note anime as a daily upload.

The anime debuted first on Amazon Prime Video in Japan on July 3, before airing on television on July 10. Anime Times is also streaming the anime on Amazon Prime Video in India as it airs in Japan.

Kenichi Imaizumi ( Kingdom season 3-6) is directing the anime at animation studio42 , and Kunihiko Okada ( The Demon Sword Master of Excalibur Academy , From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman , Apocalypse Bringer Mynoghra ) is overseeing the series scripts. Keiichi Tsuboyama ( Fireworks, Should We See it from the Side or the Bottom? animation director) is designing the characters.

Japanese-Korean pop-rock band CROWN HEAD performs the opening theme song "Wonder," and Kaya performs the ending theme song "Hoshi Furu Yoru no Yakusoku" (The Promise of the Night of Falling Stars).

J-Novel Club publishes the novel series and its manga adaptation in English, and it describes the "slow-life fantasy" story:

Dias finally returns home after decades of war. He's hailed as a hero and promptly rewarded with his own domain...which turns out to be little more than empty plains. Population: zero. Dias, who has only ever known battle, finds himself at a loss. How is he supposed to survive, let alone cultivate his territory into a thriving, prosperous dominion when there's nothing but grass as far as can see? Fortunately for Dias, a horned girl by the name of Alna is about to show him there's more to the plains than meets the eye!

Fuurou began serializing the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō service on January 20, 2018. The Earth Star Novel imprint publishes the novel series with illustrations by Kinta , and Yumbo (who is credited in the anime's staff listing) is drawing the manga adaptation with 14 volumes so far. The franchise has over two million copies in circulation so far.
author: ANN

title: Gundam Seed Freedom UK Collectors Blu-ray Released on Monday
content:
"In C.E.75, the fighting still continues. There are independence movements and aggression by Blue Cosmos… In order to calm the situation, a global peace-monitoring agency called COMPASS is established, with Lacus as its first president. As members of COMPASS, Kira and his comrades intervene into various regional battles. Then, a newly established nation called Kingdom of Foundation proposes a joint operation against a Blue Cosmos stronghold..."

The film is a sequel to the series Mobile Suit Gundam Seed and Mobile Suit Gundam Seed Destiny . Mobile Suit Gundam Seed director Mitsuo Fukuda directed the film at Bandai Namco Filmworks . Fukuda also co-wrote the script along with his late wife Chiaki Morosawa and Liu Goto . Hisashi Hirai ( Mobile Suit Gundam Seed ) designed the characters.

"After stopping the Petrification Kingdom, Senku and his friends set their sights on the moon. The plan is for a voyage team with a revived Tsukasa to gather resources in America. But the path to progress has a roadblock - another genius scientist!"

title: Übel Blatt II Manga Ends on October 23
content:
This year's ninth issue of Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine announced on Tuesday that Etorouji Shiono 's Übel Blatt II: Knights of the Fallen King ( Übel Blatt II: Shiseru Ō no Kishidan ) manga will end in the manga's next chapter. The manga will take a break next month, and will end in this year's 11th issue of Monthly Big Gangan on October 23.

Yen Press licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

One year after the battle with Glenn, Köinzell—now serving as Viceroy Ascheriit within the Imperial Army led by Empress Elsaria—is deployed to quell the rebellions that continue to plague the realm. Alongside him, Commander in Chief Geranpen, Chief Consul Aht, and Blatt Meister Ichfeis join forces to defend the Empire and support Elsaria. Through it all, in the remote southern territory of Helenirdo, a resistance group calling themselves the Knights of the Fallen King, who believe in Glenn's resurrection, begins to move in the shadows. The fates of Köinzell and the Seven Heroes have once again become inextricably intertwined...

Shiono launched the sequel manga in Monthly Big Gangan magazine in February 2024. Square Enix published the manga's fourth compiled book volume on April 24. Manga UP! Global is also releasing the manga in English digitally.

Square Enix 's Young Gangan magazine began serializing Shiono's original Übel Blatt manga in 2004. In 2011, a side story manga titled Übel Blatt Gaiden ran in Young Gangan Big , the spinoff of the Young Gangan . After a two-year hiatus, the main series returned to Big Gangan magazine in 2011. The 23rd and final compiled book volume shipped in Japan in June 2019. Yen Press has released all of Übel Blatt in English, and is also releasing the manga in 3-in-1 omnibus editions. Manga UP! added the original Übel Blatt manga in December 2023.

The television anime of the manga debuted in January 2025. The anime streamed worldwide on Amazon Prime Video . The anime received an English dub in April 2025.

title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Previews Episode 11
content:
BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA previewed Episode 11 on Tuesday. The episode is titled “That was fun,” and will premiere on August 27, at 11:00 PM JST. Crunchyroll and Muse Asia are streaming the series. Episode 11 synopsis: If we stay close, it’s truly warm. If we hadn’t separated, it should have been fine. But, that fire will no longer stop.

Midori Goto ( BanG Dream! It’s MyGo!!!!! , Ave Mujica: The Die is Cast ) is writing the script for the episode with Kotaro Ogawa directing and Kayoko Ezoe ( Rooster Fighter ) on storyboard.

NICHICALINE is animating the series. Tomomi Umezu is directing, and Hiroshi Morita is the assistant director. Midori Goto is in charge of the series composition, while Osamu Nobusawa and Mochipuyo are in charge of character design. The cast includes:

• Arale Nakamachi (vocals)

• Nonoka Miyanaga (lead guitar)

• Ritsu Minetsuki (rhythm guitar)

• Miyako Fuji (keyboard)

• Yuno Sengoku (DJ)

• Kaede Hondo as Viola

• Wakana Maruoka as Bell

title: Every Major Exciting One Piece Project Coming in 2027
content:
One Piece is by far one of the biggest franchises in the entertainment industry, and despite the manga series reaching its conclusion and clearly being only a few years away from ending, the franchise continues to grow. The feats the franchise has achieved are unprecedented, with the manga having been serialized for more than two and a half decades and becoming the highest-selling comic series of all time.

The franchise has also expanded in several other ways in recent years, with a live-action series, movies, and a remake all in the works. Recently, a new announcement for the series was also made, and with it, One Piece now has a total of three major projects that fans should be very excited about, all of which are coming in 2027.

3) The One Piece

Netflix announced the reboot project for the One Piece anime by WIT Studio all the way back in December 2023. Since then, fans have been very excited to see where this new project by a beloved studio will head. The latest information has confirmed that this new anime, which aims to modernize the series and make it more accessible to newer fans, is set to be released in February 2027.

It has also been confirmed that the upcoming reboot will include a total of seven episodes, with each episode having a runtime of around 40+ minutes, meaning it will adapt a major first arc of the series. This project has been one of the most exciting projects the franchise has announced, and it will be amazing to finally see it realized and experience the beginning of One Piece again with modern animation and better pacing meant to address the issues of the original anime.

2) One Piece Live-Action Season 3

Another One Piece project also comes under Netflix, and undoubtedly, bringing One Piece to life as a live-action series was one of the best decisions the streaming platform could have made, as the series has honestly emerged as a near-perfect adaptation. While the focus of the first season was to make the live-action format work, the second season expanded the action elements of the series, making it bigger and bolder. Season 3 has also been announced and will pick up from where the second season left off.

This season is also aiming to be even bigger than the second season , as it will adapt the first major battle arc, the Alabasta arc, from the source material. Filming for the season is already complete, and it already has a release window for next year. Fans can expect the exciting third season to arrive in Summer or Fall 2027, making the franchise even bigger and better.

1) One Piece Anime’s First Canon Movie

The most recent exciting news emerged from the One Piece Day 2026 event this past weekend, which revealed that Toei Animation is working on two new anime movies . However, the movie coming next year, One Piece God Valley , exceeded expectations, as it will be the first movie to directly adapt pages from the manga. One Piece God Valley, as the name suggests, will adapt the God Valley arc that the Elbaph arc in the manga has depicted.

The release window for this canon movie is slated for Summer 2027. This indicates that the anime will likely adapt up to the events of God Valley by then, finally depicting this exciting event on the big screen. This is by far the most exciting One Piece project of next year, and it also positions the series to follow the trend of adapting manga arcs into movies. While other arcs of the series may not have worked as well, the God Valley arc is perfect for this format, as it is filled with exciting turns that will surely blow fans’ minds on the big screen.

title: Crunchyroll’s Hottest New Shonen Anime Has Created the Perfect New Action Hero in Just Eight Episodes
content:
The Summer 2026 season is packed with diverse anime; however, it wouldn’t feel complete without a shonen anime, and this is exactly what Crunchyroll is providing with Black Torch . Since the start of the season, Black Torch has emerged as the perfect shonen anime, embracing familiar tropes that have defined the genre. One of the best elements Black Torch has incorporated is its main hero, who consistently embodies the qualities of a classic shonen protagonist. Jiro Azuma instantly emerges as the physically powerful and hopeful protagonist that a shonen hero usually represents.

However, what further amplified his position was the first episode giving him an inner demon power, a trope that has become synonymous with shonen protagonists. Jiro gains Rago, a legendary mononoke, the spirits that humans are currently at war with. The first episode itself solidified their bond, as Rago had to use Jiro as his vessel to heal from a fatal injury. Their bond has only progressed since then, with the seventh episode already seeing Jiro gain a new transformation that represents the pinnacle of their power. Now, the eighth episode of the series, the latest, has incorporated one more defining characteristic of a shonen protagonist, cementing Jiro as a perfect new action shonen hero.

Black Torch ‘s Protagonist Has Emerged as the Perfect New Action Shonen Hero

With all these elements established by the eighth episode, Jiro had already emerged as the perfect new shonen protagonist , possessing all the best traits of the genre. However, the latest episode also incorporated one more defining trait of a shonen hero that is usually only seen in the later stages of a series. After the latest major fight, Jiro and Rago are confronted by Amagi, the spirit leading the Mononoke in the current war. With Jiro unconscious after his latest transformation, Amagi forces Rago to join the Mononoke’s side, but Rago refuses. Fortunately, Jiro is saved by the arrival of the new team members, although Amagi still manages to capture Rago.

However, the twist at the end of the episode reveals that Rago gave all of his powers to Jiro, and now he is nothing more than a cat. This action from Rago has effectively eliminated the threat of Jiro gradually dying due to Rago consuming his vital energy, but the two have been separated, and Amagi seemingly also killed Rago. Jiro has already emerged as the shonen protagonist who has gained the perfect power but lost his companion. Fans have seen this trope with other shonen protagonists as well, with Naruto being the prime example, as he gained Baryon Mode through Kurama’s sacrifice.

These moments in a shonen hero’s journey often make it clear that their journey has reached its conclusion. However, Black Torch has already incorporated this trope, largely because the narrative of the series itself is very short. Adapting all 19 chapters of the manga is a quick job, and given the pacing, the series might actually conclude within three or four more episodes. Even with its short narrative, Black Torch has positioned its protagonist with the perfect shonen hero tropes, which only highlights that, had the original manga had a longer run , Black Torch might have emerged as an even better new shonen anime on Crunchyroll in 2026, becoming one of its mainstays alongside Jujutsu Kaisen , Demon Slayer , and Black Clover .
